sentences.en: Good afternoon.
sentences.zh: 下午好。

sentences.en: My name's Mrs Carter and I run the before and after school extended hours childcare service.
sentences.zh: 我叫卡特夫人，负责运营本校的课前与课后延时托管服务。

sentences.en: I hope you've had a chance to have a good look around the school and talk to staff and pupils.
sentences.zh: 希望各位已有机会仔细参观学校，并与教职工及学生进行了交流。

sentences.en: I know that many of you are interested in using our childcare service when your child joins the school, and perhaps you already know something about it, but for those that don't, I'll go through the main details now.
sentences.zh: 我知道在座许多家长都希望孩子入学后使用我们的托管服务，或许您已对此有所了解；但对尚不熟悉的朋友，我现在将为大家介绍主要细节。

sentences.en: We offer childcare for children from the ages of four to eleven both before and after school.
sentences.zh: 我们为四至十一岁的儿童提供课前与课后的托管服务。

sentences.en: I know that many parents who work find this service invaluable.
sentences.zh: 我知道，许多在职家长发现这项服务极为宝贵。

sentences.en: You can leave your child with us safe in the knowledge that they will be extremely well cared for.
sentences.zh: 您可以放心地把孩子交给我们，因为他们将得到极佳的照护。

sentences.en: We are insured to provide care for up to 70 children, although we rarely have this many attending at any one session.
sentences.zh: 我们投保的服务容量为最多70名儿童，尽管实际上每次活动很少达到这一人数。

sentences.en: I think we generally expect around 50–60 children for the afternoon sessions and about half that number for the breakfast sessions .
sentences.zh: 我想下午场次一般有50至60名儿童参加，而早餐场次人数约为其一半。

sentences.en: Although we currently do have 70 children registered with us, not all of these attend every day.
sentences.zh: 虽然目前我们登记在册的儿童已达70名，但并非所有儿童每天都来。

sentences.en: It's ten years since we began offering an extended hours service and we've come a long way during that time.
sentences.zh: 我们开展延时托管服务已有十年，这些年取得了长足发展。

sentences.en: When we first opened, we only had about 20 children attending regularly .
sentences.zh: 刚开办时，仅有约20名儿童定期参加。

sentences.en: We try to keep our costs as low as we can and we think we provide very good value for money.
sentences.zh: 我们努力将成本控制在最低水平，并认为所提供的服务物有所值。

sentences.en: For the afternoon sessions, which run from 3.30 until 6 p.m., it's £7.20.
sentences.zh: 下午场次从下午3:30持续至下午6:00，费用为7.20英镑。

sentences.en: But if you prefer, you can pay for one hour only, which costs £3.50, or two hours which costs £5.70.
sentences.zh: 但如果您愿意，您也可以仅支付一小时的费用，为3.50英镑；或两小时，为5.70英镑。

sentences.en: The cost of the childcare includes food and snacks.
sentences.zh: 儿童看护费用包含食物和点心。

sentences.en: They'll be given breakfast in the morning and in the afternoon, a healthy snack as soon as they finish school.
sentences.zh: 孩子们早上会享用早餐，下午放学后会立即提供一份健康点心。

sentences.en: At 5 p.m. children are given something more substantial, such as pasta or a casserole.
sentences.zh: 下午5点，孩子们会享用一份更丰盛的食物，例如意大利面或炖菜。

sentences.en: Please inform us of any allergies that your child might have and we'll make sure they're offered a suitable alternative.
sentences.zh: 请务必告知我们您的孩子是否有任何过敏情况，我们将确保为其提供合适的替代餐食。

sentences.en: As you may know, the childcare service runs through the school holidays from 8 a.m. to p.m.
sentences.zh: 如您所知，儿童看护服务在学假期间照常运行，时间为上午8点至下午（原文未明确结束时间）。

sentences.en: We offer a really varied and exciting programme to keep the children entertained – we don't want them to feel as if they are still at school!
sentences.zh: 我们提供内容丰富且富有吸引力的活动项目，以确保孩子们玩得开心——我们不希望他们感觉好像仍在学校上课！

sentences.en: It will also feel different because they'll get the chance to make new friends with children from other schools – spaces are available for them because a lot of our term-time children don't always attend during the holiday.
sentences.zh: 活动氛围也会有所不同，因为他们将有机会结识来自其他学校的新朋友——由于我们学期中许多孩子在假期期间并不总是参加，因此名额对这些孩子是开放的。

sentences.en: In the past, parents have asked if children over the age of 11 are allowed to come with their younger brothers and sisters – but I'm afraid we're unable to do this because of the type of insurance we have.
sentences.zh: 过去，曾有家长询问：11岁以上的孩子是否可以陪同年幼的弟弟妹妹一同参加？但很抱歉，由于我们所投保的保险类型限制，我们无法允许这样做。

sentences.en: So now let me tell you about some of the activities that your child can do during the after- school sessions.
sentences.zh: 接下来，让我为您介绍一下您的孩子在课后托管期间可参与的部分活动。

sentences.en: As well as being able to use the playground equipment, computers and /12 /12 更多雅思干货，添加教主微信：519690129
sentences.zh: 除了可以使用游乐场设施、电脑以及……
